data.text: Welcome to LLM Notetaker, a powerful knowledge management system that combines structured note-taking with AI-powered chat functionality and document analysis capabilities.
LLM Notetaker is designed to help you organize, create, and interact with your knowledge base through multiple channels:

items: Rich Note Editor: Create structured notes using EditorJS with support for headers, lists, tables, code blocks, quotes, and images
AI Chat Interface: Ask questions, get summaries, and generate content using advanced language models
Document Analysis (RAG): Upload PDFs, DOCX, and CSV files for AI-powered analysis and question answering
File Viewer: Browse and preview uploaded documents with integrated chat functionality
Organizational Tools: Folders, tags, and cross-references to keep your knowledge organized

data.text: The application is built with modern web technologies and AI frameworks:
Understanding how data is organized helps you make the most of the application:

items: Nodes: Core data structure representing notes, folders, and chats
Hierarchical Organization: Folders can contain subfolders and notes in a tree structure
Tags: Flexible labeling system for cross-cutting organization
Content Blocks: EditorJS stores content as JSON blocks (paragraphs, headers, lists, etc.)
Chat Messages: Conversations stored with timestamps, sources, and metadata
File Uploads: Documents stored with metadata and vector embeddings for search

data.text: LLM Notetaker excels at connecting different types of content:

items: Internal Links: Link between notes using the note-link syntax
External References: Include web links that open in new tabs
Document References: Chat about specific uploaded documents
Tag-based Discovery: Find related content through shared tags
Full-text Search: Search across all notes and chat history

data.text: The power of LLM Notetaker lies in its ability to seamlessly blend structured note-taking with conversational AI, creating a unified knowledge workspace.
